entities.name: Q8RG83 orotidine decarboxylase
observations: The provided 237-aa sequence is an exact sequence-hash match to reviewed UniProt Q8RG83 from Fusobacterium nucleatum.
Catalyzes orotidine 5'-monophosphate decarboxylation to uridine 5'-monophosphate; EC 4.1.1.23.

entities.name: OMP decarboxylation
observations: Orotidine 5'-phosphate + H+ → UMP + CO2; Rhea RHEA:11596, EC 4.1.1.23.

entities.name: Orotidine 5'-phosphate
observations: Substrate in the annotated OMP decarboxylation reaction; also termed OMP.

entities.name: Uridine 5'-monophosphate
observations: Product of OMP decarboxylation; also termed UMP.

entities.name: Carbon dioxide
observations: Released product in the decarboxylation of OMP to UMP.
